proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D hABD h1 h2
  have hli : ∀ a b : ℝ, a • (B -ᵥ A) + b • (D -ᵥ A) = (0 : V) → a = 0 ∧ b = 0 := by
    intro a b h
    by_contra hab
    apply hABD
    rcases not_and_or.mp hab with ha | hb
    · have hB : B -ᵥ A = (-b / a) • (D -ᵥ A) := by
        have h2 : a • (B -ᵥ A) = (-b) • (D -ᵥ A) := by
          rw [neg_smul]; exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h
        rw [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, ← h2, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_smul]
      have h3 := AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair (-b / a) A D
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, ← hB, vsub_vadd] at h3
      have h4 := collinear_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair h3
      rwa [Set.insert_comm] at h4
    · have hC : D -ᵥ A = (-a / b) • (B -ᵥ A) := by
        have h2 : b • (D -ᵥ A) = (-a) • (B -ᵥ A) := by
          rw [neg_smul]; exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h
        rw [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, ← h2, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hb, one_smul]
      have h3 := AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair (-a / b) A B
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, ← hC, vsub_vadd] at h3
      have h4 := collinear_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair h3
      rwa [Set.insert_comm, Set.pair_comm] at h4
  rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev] at h1 h2
  have m1 : C -ᵥ D ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {B -ᵥ A} := by rw [h1]; exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
  have m2 : C -ᵥ B ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {D -ᵥ A} := by rw [h2]; exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp m1
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp m2
  have e1 : C -ᵥ D = (C -ᵥ A) - (D -ᵥ A) := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C D A).symm
  have e2 : C -ᵥ B = (C -ᵥ A) - (B -ᵥ A) := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C B A).symm
  have h0 : (a - 1) • (B -ᵥ A) + (1 - b) • (D -ᵥ A) = (0 : V) := by
    have h3 : (C -ᵥ A) = a • (B -ᵥ A) + (D -ᵥ A) := by rw [ha, e1]; abel
    have h4 : (C -ᵥ A) = b • (D -ᵥ A) + (B -ᵥ A) := by rw [hb, e2]; abel
    have : (a • (B -ᵥ A) + (D -ᵥ A)) - (b • (D -ᵥ A) + (B -ᵥ A)) = (0 : V) := by rw [← h3, ← h4, sub_self]
    rw [← this]; module
  obtain ⟨h5, -⟩ := hli _ _ h0
  have h6 : a = 1 := by linarith
  rw [← ha, h6, one_smul]
